title: Move broad dispatch interfaces to their consumers
prompt:
The dispatch provider's exported `dispatch.Service` interface has grown into a six-method grab bag. The two packages that consume it now have the wrong dependency shape: `internal/httpapi` needs only run lookup and cancellation, while `internal/worker` needs only ready-listing and dispatch marking. Their checked-in generated fakes implement all six methods too, so every unrelated provider change fans out through both consumers.

Slim this boundary without changing runtime behavior. Remove the provider-owned `dispatch.Service` interface. Define `RunService` in `internal/httpapi` with exactly `GetRun(context.Context, string) (dispatch.Run, error)` and `CancelRun(context.Context, string) error`, and make `Handler` plus `New` depend on it. Define `DispatchQueue` in `internal/worker` with exactly `ListReady(context.Context, int) ([]dispatch.Run, error)` and `MarkDispatched(context.Context, string) error`, and make `Runner` plus `New` depend on it. Do not introduce aliases, adapters, or replacement interfaces in `internal/dispatch`; the concrete `*dispatch.MemoryService` must satisfy both consumer contracts directly, and all six of its existing public methods must remain available with unchanged signatures.

Regenerate the two checked-in fake artifacts in place (the generator itself is not vendored): `httpapi.FakeRunService` must implement only `RunService`, and `worker.FakeDispatchQueue` only `DispatchQueue`. Preserve their generated banner, hook fields, mutex-protected call recording, and panic-on-missing-hook convention, but remove hooks, call records, and methods outside each role.

This is dependency slimming only. Preserve request-context propagation, wrapped-error classification, HTTP status/body behavior, worker list-error identity, bounded parallelism, first-mark-error identity, sibling cancellation, and race safety. Do not modify `go.mod` or any test. Run `go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30s ./...`.
verify_cmd: env GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOCACHE=/tmp/go-interface-slimming-cache GOPATH=/tmp/go-interface-slimming-gopath XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/go-interface-slimming-config GOTELEMETRY=off GOENV=off GOWORK=off go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30s ./...

full_distill.primary_skill: replace a broad provider-owned Go interface with exact consumer-owned role interfaces and regenerate dependent fakes without altering context, error, or concurrency semantics
full_distill.baseline_evidence: go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30s ./... fails the protected source contract because dispatch.Service still owns all six methods, both consumers name that broad type, and both generated fakes retain unrelated hooks and methods; the protected behavioral packages otherwise pass
full_distill.success_contract: the provider exports no Service interface, each consumer owns the exact two methods it invokes, MemoryService wires directly into both constructors, each generated fake contains only its role, and all pinned HTTP, cancellation, error-identity, parallelism, and race behavior remains unchanged
adversarial_factors: the protected AST contract rejects consumer aliases, renamed provider interfaces, adapters, broad constructor fields, and lingering dispatch.Service selectors
reflection and source checks pin all six concrete MemoryService methods while requiring each generated fake to expose only its two role methods and no unrelated hooks or call records
HTTP tests pass request-scoped values through both operations and use wrapped sentinels plus canceled contexts, rejecting background-context substitution and direct error equality
a gated worker test proves the configured parallelism is both reached and never exceeded without clocks or sleeps
a deterministic first-error scenario holds sibling marks in flight, then requires the original error object back and requires every sibling to observe derived-context cancellation
concurrent calls exercise the checked-in fake recorders under the race detector, rejecting removal or misuse of their mutex protection
